t: AWS Secrets Manager adds managed external secrets support for Databricks and Twilio
x: AWS Secrets Manager now extends its managed external secrets capability to include Databricks and Twilio, enabling you to automatically rotate the credentials that your data pipelines and messaging.

t: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports index-level encryption
x: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports index-level encryption, letting you encrypt each index at rest with its own AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key.

t: AWS Backup now supports Amazon FSx file systems in the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region
x: AWS Backup now supports Amazon FSx for Lustre, Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, Amazon FSx for OpenZFS, and Amazon FSx for Windows File Server in the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region.

t: AWS Security Hub now supports resource criticality for prioritization
x: Today, AWS Security Hub adds resource criticality to exposure prioritization, helping central security teams focus on the exposures that threaten their most business-critical resources.

t: AWS Transfer Family now supports AWS Secrets Manager storage for SFTP server host keys
x: AWS Transfer Family now lets you store SFTP server host keys in AWS Secrets Manager in your own AWS account.

t: AWS HealthOmics now supports shared VPCs
x: AWS HealthOmics now supports sharing VPCs across accounts, enabling your workflows to access resources in Amazon Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs) managed by other AWS accounts with AWS Resource Access.

t: AWS Security Hub CSPM now supports the Cyber Risk Institute profile version 2.2
x: AWS Security Hub CSPM now supports automated security checks that align with the Cyber Risk Institute (CRI) profile.

t: Amazon MSK Connect and AWS Glue Schema Registry are now available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) region
x: Starting today, Amazon MSK Connect and the AWS Glue Schema Registry are available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) region.

t: Amazon SageMaker Studio simplifies getting started for new AI/ML builders with new sign-in options

t: Amazon CloudWatch log centralization now available in AWS GovCloud and additional commercial Regions
x: Amazon CloudWatch log centralization is now available in AWS GovCloud (US) and 13 additional commercial Regions.
